title: The non-terrestrial officers spreadsheet
place_text: a US Navy system (accessed from London)

tellings.quote: this spreadsheet was titled non-terrestrial officers, so not on the Earth, which isn't necessarily alien. It could just mean space-based marines or, you know, secret space force.
it was transfers of weird chemicals like malibdenum and other weird things that are hard to pronounce. Uh, shipto- ship transfers and fleetto fleet transfers.

as_told.place_text: a US Navy system (accessed from London)

tellings.quote: Yeah. I've always thought there weren't aliens. I thought this is bound to be because it says non-aterrestrial obviously, not extraterrestrial.

as_told.title: Non-terrestrial officers list read as an off-Earth fleet / space supply chain

plain: Gary McKinnon, a hacker from London who says he broke into US military computers between 2000 and 2002, says that inside a US Navy system he found a spreadsheet titled "non-terrestrial officers," along with records of transfers of unusual chemicals like molybdenum and of ship-to-ship and fleet-to-fleet transfers. McKinnon, telling what he says he saw himself, reads "non-terrestrial" as meaning off the Earth rather than alien, perhaps space-based marines or a secret space force, and mentions Jesse Michels and a man named James Fox in the telling. If true, it would point to a hidden fleet and supply chain in space.
